notes.title: PATCH NOTES - 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Multiple quality-of-life fixes
 Fixed a distraction-related achievement not unlocking
 Adjusted the placements of elements on the loading screen
 Fixed bug where the game would crash when trying to access the leaderboard after your first game
 Removed a distraction for being too difficult
 Decreased the number of spiked floors in the RUN game at a time from 4 to 3
 Increased the points given in the RUN game from 125 to 150

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - v1.0.6
notes.notes:
Made the bowl in the catch minigame move slightly faster
 Added debug mode; this shows technical information such as frames-per-second and the current game room to make it easier to report bugs. To enable debug mode, right-click F*ck This Game in your library, and type "-db" into the Launch Options box (with no quotes - include the hyphen).

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - v1.0.5
notes.notes:
Fixed crash that would occur when attempting to open the leaderboards after getting a game over
 Added credits line for original version of game
 Fug bixes

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - v1.0.4
notes.notes:
Another update for FTG! Let's see what we've got...


 Added Spanish translation (thanks LaurenBlitz!)
 Fixed collision issues with the cut minigame
 Fixed collision issues with the center tumbleweed in the drive minigame
 Fixed random chances for easter eggs in push and jump minigames
 Added new rare easter egg in drive minigame
 Added new distraction
 Bug fixes and quality of life improvements


This should be the last update for a while! I believe I've taken care of most, if not all gigantic issues. Please keep informing me of any more that you come across, and I'll do my best to fix them all!

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - v1.0.2
notes.notes:
Another update for FTG! Let's see what we've got...

 Added a secret rare easter egg in the push minigame
